messages:
izzy: quick check-in on the tiny docs panel we ship on the Routes dashboard. found a handful of small consistency and a11y things we should fix before next deploy.
ryan: list them out and we can assign.
izzy: 1) Mixed vocab: UI cards show 'routing policy' header, but some docs examples say 'route policy' and a few help snippets use 'routing rules'. pick one canonical phrase. i recommend 'routing policy' to match the console label.
devin: agree with 'routing policy' (matches telemetry and API). we'll sweep docs examples.
izzy: 2) Deeplinks: the panel's "Examples" link opens the docs page but not the specific section. users expect to land at the example block. can we add per-section anchors and make the small target icon open the doc at the anchor?
a11y-bot: a11y-bot: note: when linking to anchors, include a short hidden summary at the destination heading for screen readers (e.g., "Examples: routing policy usage"). also ensure the target icon has aria-label="Open docs: routing policy examples" and is keyboard focusable.
dryn: (typo) ^^ devin: we should also fall back to top-of-doc if anchor missing. docs-bot: docs-bot: created issue #714 to add anchors for routing-policy-examples and routing-policy-overview: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/714
izzy: 3) CTA text: current primary says "Documentation" which is passive. let's use action-first copy: for example cards use "See routing examples", for overview use "Open docs". keep the desktop button visible but on mobile move it into an overflow menu to reduce clutter.
devin: will implement context-sensitive CTA with fallback.
izzy: 4) Focus management: when the panel opens, focus should move into panel heading. when it closes, focus should return to the trigger. i noticed that ESC closes the panel in Chrome but not on Firefox in my tests. add consistent key handling and a focus-return hook.
a11y-bot: also include aria-live="polite" announcement when panel opens: "Help panel opened: routing policy". ensure the panel uses role="dialog" and that ESC closes it across browsers.
izzy: 5) Tiny glossary: support calls show users confused by 'prefetch', 'KV cache', and 'dedicated capacity'. propose a small 3-term glossary at the bottom of the panel, collapsed by default, implemented as a disclosure with aria-expanded state.
devin: collapsed disclosure it is. on mobile it will live in the footer overflow menu.
izzy: final ask: include a mapping file in the repo (ui-term -> docs-term -> canonical) so we can avoid divergence next time. devin, can you add that?
devin: yes, i'll add a 1-file mapping and link it in the docs PR.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened PR #659: add anchors + glossary markup + replace 'route policy' -> 'routing policy' in examples. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/659
izzy: awesome. next steps: devin to post a tiny spec with copy + aria labels; a11y-bot will run quick checklist after demo; i'll triage into sprint once PR lands.
ryan: thanks all, ping this thread when PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Design review for in-product docs panel on Routes: unify 'routing policy' terminology, add per-section anchors and keyboard-focusable target icon, change CTAs to action-first text and move extras into mobile overflow, ensure consistent focus trap/ESC across browsers and announce panel opening with aria-live, add collapsed 3-term glossary, and add a canonical term mapping file. docs-bot linked PR/issue.
